scope: Held out from future DFT-label fitting only; all groups were historically MACE-screened.

rules.grouping: exact composition; every seed/site/intermediate of a group stays in its split
rules.selection: Enumerate eligible four-group holdouts; maximize minimum then total element coverage across both splits, composition SHA256 tie-break; seed/site hashes modulo 3/4
rules.replacement: none; retain all pending, failed, ambiguous, and unconverged slots
rules.downstream_holdout: Freeze fitting/threshold rules using discovery DFT labels before inspecting heldout DFT labels.
rules.stratification: Composition-only element coverage in both splits whenever feasible; no outcome-based stratification. Report coverage counts; a 4-group test cannot establish generalization across chemistry.
rules.pilot_scope: One chain per composition is a pilot; it cannot validate the full candidate ranking.
rules.extension: If unresolved, extend to all seeds 0,1,2 and sites 0,1,2,3 within the same composition split; keep all pilot cases. Redesign informed by heldout labels needs a new evaluation set.
rules.state_selection: Retain each selected site's census minimum-energy start, including non-intact and unconverged states; never substitute another site.
